decisions.reason: It builds directly on our tube and materials expertise and the award in 2019 is a strong early signal that we can recognize, refine, and commercialize this related geothermal solution.

As a closely related geothermal probe based on our existing knowledge in tubes, systems, and tailored technical solutions, it fits a field where our absorptive capacity should let us improve market acceptance over time.

This surface technology is highly complementary to our established materials and processing capabilities, so even with limited public results we are well placed to learn from early use and enhance it commercially.

A fire-protection steel profile system is very close to our core building-systems business, making it a natural candidate to retain because our existing know-how, quality management, and customer relationships support further development and sales.

The slim steel profile system is an adjacent product in our strongest knowledge domain, and a large German metal manufacturer would typically keep such a related innovation to deepen customized offerings rather than exit early.

This decorative steel profile surface system extends our established profile and surface capabilities, so our existing technical and market knowledge should allow continued adaptation for customer-specific applications.
